fact_statement: Mashreq Bank will NEVER ask for your OTP, PIN, or password through phone calls, SMS, or email. All such requests are fraudulent.
All official Mashreq communications come from verified email domains ending in @mashreq.com or @mashreqbank.com only.
The Mashreq mobile app uses biometric authentication (fingerprint/face ID) and 256-bit encryption for all transactions.
Customers can instantly freeze their cards through the Mashreq app if they suspect unauthorized activity.
Two-factor authentication (2FA) is mandatory for all online banking transactions above AED 1,000.
Mashreq employs 24/7 fraud monitoring systems that automatically flag suspicious transactions.
Account login attempts are limited to 3 tries. After 3 failed attempts, the account is temporarily locked for security.
Mashreq uses tokenization for all card-not-present transactions, meaning actual card numbers are never shared with merchants.
All Mashreq ATMs are equipped with anti-skimming technology and encrypted PIN pads.
Customers receive real-time SMS and push notifications for all account transactions above AED 100.
Mashreq's Secure Key generates unique transaction codes that expire within 60 seconds.
The bank maintains SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 certifications for information security management.
Mashreq never stores CVV numbers in its systems - these must be entered fresh for each transaction.
Password changes require verification through registered mobile number or email, plus security questions.
International transactions are blocked by default and must be enabled by the customer through the app or customer service.
Mashreq partners with UAE Central Bank's AANI instant payment system for secure domestic transfers.
All bank staff undergo regular security training and background checks as per UAE Central Bank regulations.
Session timeout for online banking is set to 5 minutes of inactivity for security purposes.
Device registration is required for new logins - unrecognized devices trigger additional verification steps.
Mashreq's fraud investigation team responds to reported incidents within 24 hours.
Neo (digital) accounts have zero monthly maintenance fees for the first year.
Standard savings accounts have a monthly fee of AED 25, waived if minimum balance of AED 3,000 is maintained.
Domestic transfers via AANI are free for all Mashreq customers.
International wire transfers cost AED 50 plus exchange rate margin of up to 2%.
ATM withdrawals at Mashreq ATMs are unlimited and free. Non-Mashreq ATMs incur AED 2 per transaction.
Credit card annual fees range from AED 0 (Solitaire) to AED 750 (Platinum) depending on the card type.
Late payment fees on credit cards are AED 200 or 5% of the minimum due, whichever is higher.
Cheque book issuance is free for the first 25 leaves per year; additional leaves cost AED 1 each.
Account closure within 6 months of opening incurs an early closure fee of AED 100.
Currency conversion fees on debit card purchases abroad are 2.75% of the transaction amount.
SMS banking alerts are free for the first 20 per month; additional alerts cost AED 0.30 each.
Balance certificate issuance costs AED 50, liability letters cost AED 100.
Stop payment on cheques costs AED 50 per instruction.
Salary transfer account holders receive fee waivers on most standard services.
Dormant account reactivation fee is AED 50, charged after 12 months of inactivity.
Scheduled maintenance windows are every Sunday from 2:00 AM to 4:00 AM UAE time.
The Mashreq app requires iOS 14.0+ or Android 8.0+ to function properly.
Push notifications require app version 5.0 or higher to work correctly.
Face ID login is only available on iPhone X and newer models.
The app automatically logs out after 5 minutes of inactivity for security.
Real-time notifications may experience delays of up to 30 seconds during peak hours.
UAE Pass integration for instant account opening is available in app version 6.0+.
International roaming may cause temporary connectivity issues with the app - use WiFi when abroad.
The web banking portal is accessible 24/7 as an alternative when the app is under maintenance.
Biometric login can be reset through the 'Forgot Password' flow if fingerprint/face is not recognized.
App cache should be cleared if experiencing persistent login issues - Settings > Storage > Clear Cache.
Dark mode is available in app version 5.5+ under Settings > Display.
Neo is Mashreq's digital-only banking product with instant account opening via UAE Pass.
Personal loans are available from AED 5,000 to AED 3 million with terms from 12 to 48 months.
Home loans (mortgages) offer up to 80% financing for UAE nationals and 75% for expatriates.
Credit card limit increases can be requested every 6 months based on credit history.
Business accounts require trade license, Emirates ID, and minimum initial deposit of AED 10,000.
Mashreq Gold savings account offers tiered interest rates up to 2.5% APY on balances above AED 100,000.
Fixed deposit terms range from 1 month to 5 years with interest rates from 2% to 4.5% APY.
The Mashreq Platinum card includes complimentary airport lounge access (2 visits per quarter).
Car loans are available for new and used vehicles up to 5 years old with financing up to 80%.
Mashreq Investment services require minimum investment of AED 50,000 for managed portfolios.
Overdraft facilities are available for salary account holders with limits up to 2x monthly salary.
Joint accounts are available for married couples with either 'Either or Survivor' or 'Both to Sign' operation modes.
Minor savings accounts can be opened for children aged 0-18 with guardian oversight.
Mashreq Millionaire savings account enters customers into monthly prize draws for every AED 5,000 saved.
Trade finance solutions include Letters of Credit, Bank Guarantees, and Documentary Collections.
Mashreq complies with UAE Personal Data Protection Law (PDPL) Federal Decree-Law No. 45 of 2021.
KYC (Know Your Customer) documents must be updated every 2 years as per UAE Central Bank requirements.
Large cash transactions above AED 55,000 are reported to the UAE Financial Intelligence Unit.
Account holders must notify the bank of address changes within 30 days per banking regulations.
Mashreq is regulated by the UAE Central Bank and holds a full banking license since 1967.
Customer data is stored in UAE-based data centers and never transferred outside the country without consent.
Anti-money laundering (AML) screening is performed on all international transfers.
Mashreq's privacy policy allows customers to opt out of marketing communications at any time.
The bank is required to report suspected fraud to authorities within 24 hours of detection.
Emirates ID verification is mandatory for all account-related transactions at branches.
Mashreq undergoes annual external audits by one of the Big 4 accounting firms.
Customer complaint resolution SLA is 5 business days for standard issues, 15 days for complex cases.
Tax residency self-certification (CRS/FATCA) is required for all new account holders.
Beneficial ownership declaration is required for all corporate accounts per AML regulations.
The bank's capital adequacy ratio exceeds the minimum 13% required by UAE Central Bank.
